difference.summary: The two leans are not distinguishable from each other: `gpt-5.6-terra` minus `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is -0.002 completeness [-0.042 to +0.041]. Neither judge is the more partial one on this evidence, and the larger of the two numbers above should not be read as though it were.

effects.summary: `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` shows no detectable preference for Google models: +0.017 completeness [-0.011 to +0.046], an interval that includes zero. Not detected is not the same as absent — the comparison was 3 of the vendor's own against 12 neutral, over 37 conversations.

`gpt-5.6-terra` shows no detectable preference for OpenAI models: +0.016 completeness [-0.008 to +0.043], an interval that includes zero. Not detected is not the same as absent — the comparison was 4 of the vendor's own against 12 neutral, over 37 conversations.
